reviews.text: Excellent service, I recommend it!

I highly recommend them! The veterinarian was very attentive, explained everything with great patience, and helped me better understand what care my puppy really needs. I left the appointment feeling confident that taking good care of him doesn't have to be complicated, but rather accessible ;)

Gratifying. It was a consultation with an experienced professional. Vitor is speechless, he assessed the cat from the moment he saw it and, above all, he listens to the owner, and his sensitivity in listening to us makes us feel comfortable and safe.
Truly grateful. 🫠 …
Very attentive

We are so grateful to Dr. Viktor Lima at V.Vet for the wonderful care he gave our cat, Rafael, affectionately known as Rafi!

Rafi can be very difficult to handle during veterinary visits, so we were anxious about his appointment. Dr. Viktor communicated with us beforehand and helped us prepare. His patience, kindness, and reassuring manner meant so much to us.

He successfully microchipped Rafi, gave his rabies vaccination, and even clipped his nails! What had felt like such a daunting task became a tremendous relief.

What especially touched us was his follow-up care. He checked on Rafi after we returned home and reached out again the very next morning to ask how he was recovering. By then, Rafi was eating well and back to his usual self! Dr. Viktor also made it clear that we could message him with any questions.

We felt supported before, during, and after the appointment. We are very pleased and will be returning for Rafi’s bloodwork in October. Thank you, Dr. Viktor, for looking after our precious boy with such care. We wholeheartedly recommend V.Vet!

Excellent professional! I took a rescued kitten I brought to the clinic; he was extremely stressed, not eating, and not defecating. Dr. Vitor Lima Fava was super patient, experienced, and performed an impeccable general check-up. He ordered all the necessary tests (including the FIV/FeLV test, which thankfully came back negative) and discovered a skin fungus that we are already treating. Besides being a very competent doctor, he demonstrates genuine care and love for animals. The kitten has already started eating again, is super active, and is recovering very well. I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Vitor and the V.VET clinic!

I took my kitten to the vet today and received excellent care. The doctor explained everything about the disease and treatment, prescribed medications that can be found in regular pharmacies at good prices.
A highly competent and humane veterinarian. Confident in consultations, conduct, and care. An exceptional professional with very fair prices.

We went to this clinic and they helped us a lot. Our puppy was vomiting, defecating blood, and seemed like he was on his last legs. And thank God, this clinic, which is generally close to my house, helped us. Dr. Vittorio has golden hands, truly golden hands. He helped us, guided us, drew blood, did all the tests, and also helped with other procedures. I want to emphasize that I speak poor Portuguese, but Dr. Vittorio speaks English, and that gave us peace of mind. And overall, the cost of my dog's treatment wasn't that expensive, so I recommend this clinic to everyone.
Excellent service, attentive, conveys reliability and knowledge.

I really want to express how helpful this clinic has been thus far! I am from the united states and only know little portuguese, so I was nervous about finding a vet with the language barrier. I have gotten all my questions answered, appointments scheduled promptly, and met with so much kindness with the veterinarian who knows english!! He has taken such good care of my baby Mamba… very happy to have a clinic so close to me and so kind. Also so helpful with how quick they respond to whatsapp!
Sensational doctor. They took great care of my dog ​​and won me over as a loyal customer.
A great veterinarian who truly cares about the longevity and health of animals.

Outstanding service! I took my dog, Frida, and had the best experience I've ever had at a veterinary clinic. Dr. Vitor was extremely attentive, explained everything very clearly, and showed genuine care for her. In addition to the excellent service, he offered all the support we needed. I recommend them without hesitation!
I was pleasantly surprised and very well attended to by the doctor. I hope to God that the dog gets better.
Excellent! Dr. Vitor is super attentive and careful with the animals. 💖 …
An amazing veterinarian who helped me a lot with the kitten I rescued.
The doctor provides exceptional care, is very attentive and helpful!
Excellent service!!! Dr. Vitor is very attentive to his patients and their owners, and he's an excellent professional! I took my guinea pig there and it was well worth it.
Excellent professional, sees the animal as a whole when treating or performing preventative care.
Excellent service! I recommend it.

I've taken my dogs to many appointments at different clinics, and I can say that the appointment with Dr. Vitor was the best we've ever had. It was so good and so exceptional that I left very impressed. Vitor is extremely sincere, clear, and transparent. It's almost like listening to a friend. Besides that, he has a lot of confidence and technical expertise in what he talks about. I never want to take Melzinha anywhere else again!

The veterinarian and staff were very attentive, careful, and curious. They helped us investigate and treat kidney problems and other inflammations. They also assisted us with dietary changes and preventative health treatment for Abelardo, ensuring his well-being and comfort. With the V.Vet Club, we have discounts on products and consultations, as well as security in case of emergencies. Abelardo and I highly recommend the V.Vet clinic 💚

I would like to express my immense gratitude for the care we received. I am sending this video to show the peace that Brie didn't have before; today she is healed and completely pain-free.
But, in addition to her recovery, what impressed us most was the care and dedication of the entire team.
Therefore, I extend my invitation: come and visit, sign up for the plan, because it's really worth it!
It's a great place, they take very good care of the animals. I take my pets there and they always come back in great shape.

Very good clinic, they performed the risky surgery on my elderly dog ​​and she recovered well, I recommend them to everyone who wants to take care of their pets.
I have 4 pets and he takes care of them all, excellent place and very good veterinarian too.

My kitten got sick and Vitor has been amazing with him. He was spot-on with the treatment and spared no effort until he got better. He acts very quickly and consistently. It's not the kind of place that tries to sell you things; he asks for what's truly necessary at that moment. I highly recommend him and wouldn't change him for anything! Now he'll be taking care of all my pets 😻 and I can only thank him for everything he did during this difficult time we went through.

I was drawn to the clinic's offering and I'm even more satisfied and happy with the care I receive from Dr. Vitor. He's an extremely attentive veterinarian who truly cares about the animal's well-being. I feel privileged to be able to provide this type of care for my dogs. Excellent service. Thank you very much.

If our kitten is alive today, it's thanks to the care of Dr. Vitor. His service was excellent and he provided great care. Our kitten arrived with a very complicated and serious case, and thanks to him, she is doing much better today.
"The veterinarian is extremely attentive and very competent. I am truly very satisfied."

Excellent experience with Vitor; his approach and teaching methods are outstanding, as is his care and sensitivity throughout the entire process and monitoring of our 12-year-old cat's health complications. Apolo was experiencing gastrointestinal problems, and the dietary changes Vitor suggested, along with the medications, were crucial in quickly improving his condition. He also underwent surgical removal of benign tumors in his ears, and Vitor was patient and available to provide comprehensive post-operative care to prevent any complications, as well as follow-up appointments for evaluation. In short, primarily due to the treatment provided and Vitor's availability and attention, I recommend his services to anyone needing care for their cats.

Today I went to V.Vet for the first time and we were seen by Dr. Vitor. Honestly, it was the best veterinary care experience I've ever had.
I've been to many professionals over the years and I've never had such a complete, transparent, and humane experience. He really listens to the pet owner, explains everything clearly, doesn't hide information, and tells the truth in a technical and responsible way. He answered all my questions patiently and showed genuine care for both me and my cat.
It's clear when a professional loves what they do and prioritizes the animal's well-being above all else. In addition, he made himself fully available should I need any future guidance, which gives me a lot of confidence.
I recommend him without hesitation. Outstanding service.
Excellent service. Dr. Vitor is very attentive and respectful. You can take your kittens there without fear. Very reliable.

Having access to top-notch professional service is priceless! For 3 years I've been trying to treat my pet without effective results. At V.Vet, they immediately understood what was wrong with him. He's already been medicated and treated, but his problem has no cure. However, there is treatment that will give him a good quality of life until he decides to leave home. Thank you is not enough.
Excellent service, I was very well received and satisfied with Vitor's care. I received some medication and saw results after the consultation. I highly recommend him.
Excellent veterinary clinic, humane treatment, clear and always very careful.

Humane and efficient service. We really liked Dr. Vitor's work and the way he examined and treated our kitten. I had never been there before and woke up with an emergency, and the doctor was attentive, careful, and attended to us promptly and with affection. I highly recommend Vevet, fair prices and excellent work!

Incredible service. Dr. Vitor and his team are modern and well-prepared professionals. I had a problem with my kitten, and the best thing I did was take him to the clinic. I left feeling that he received the necessary attention without being charged an arm and a leg for it.
My Sapphire is treated with great care and honesty!

Zeus arrived with a case of poorly treated infection from another professional. Dr. Vitor explained everything to me in minute detail, cleaned and medicated him. My cat was in serious condition, but thank God I found Dr. Vitor who is saving my cat!
Excellent service for all the family's pets, very dedicated young man.

Tomzinho arrived at Vitor's with a complex condition. Vitor was very clear and provided the correct guidance, directing Tom towards the specific care he needed and explaining the entire situation clearly. He needed to be hospitalized, and Vitor was supportive and concerned throughout. Now Tom continues his treatment at home and is recovering ❤️

I want to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Vitor, who promptly resolved all my concerns regarding a last-minute trip with my dog, Miguelito. Not to mention that he simply examined him and discovered many things related to his health, which greatly impressed me and made me feel valued as his owner. The world needs more vets like him. An exceptionally outstanding veterinarian. Much success and gratitude 🙏.
Excellent service!!
Dr. Vitor was very attentive, he examined my kitten, prescribed medication, and gave advice on how to care for her health. I recommend him!

I took my two guinea pigs for a check-up and was very satisfied with Dr. Vitor's care. He evaluated each one of them with great attention, affection, and patience. He was extremely meticulous in observing the signs, explaining each step, and providing guidance on the necessary daily care.

He also shared several useful tips, which made me feel more confident about their health. I really liked the service and the careful way we were received. I will definitely return whenever I need to!

Excellent location, with a clean and hygienic environment. Dr. Vitor is an exceptional professional, extremely attentive. In addition to providing excellent care and carefully examining my Apolo, he answered all my questions. He prescribed medication that, even during the consultation, began to reduce his fever. I can only express my gratitude.
Fantastic! Vitor was very attentive to Lucila, sincere and didactic. His facilities are excellent, complete, and he was able to provide service that surprised me. I recommend him!

Highly competent and committed professional. He took care of my 3-month-old rescued kittens. One of them received a correct diagnosis and treatment for tick-borne disease. No unnecessary expenses, and no stress for the kitten, with great responsibility. I recommend him.
Thank you so much, my friends, you're the best!

Veterinarian Vitor is an excellent professional! Extremely attentive, he demonstrates genuine care for the animals and their owners. He explains everything very clearly, always with patience, which conveys confidence and tranquility. Furthermore, he offers all the necessary support and is always willing to answer any questions. First-rate, humane, and competent service; without a doubt, a professional who makes a difference! I highly recommend him!!!

I rescued Fred from the street, and Victor was super attentive, very helpful, and careful. He gave me all the instructions, and I felt very reassured. He's very good at handling animals and explains everything clearly. I highly recommend him!

October 25th
Aníbal and Guadalupe had their annual check-ups at the same vet again! With a lot of attention and conversation, we are now proceeding with the best treatment for Aníbal, mainly following a natural diet. I recommend and trust him completely!

November 24th Edition
3 months ago I was already very happy with Vitor's consultation, but now I can say that he helped my cat Aníbal, who has a chronic condition, to have a healthier and happier life! Today, my kittens Aníbal and Guadalupe have the plan that makes all the difference. I couldn't be happier!

July 24th
Great consultation! Veterinarian Vitor was very attentive throughout the consultation, explaining and answering all questions. I felt very confident to follow the indicated treatment. I am very grateful for the attention he gave to my kitten.

The service at V.Vet clinic was excellent! We were very happy and relieved after taking our dog for x-rays, ultrasound, and a consultation. Everyone who attended to us was caring, attentive, and incredibly kind. I am immensely grateful to Dr. Vitor and his team.

Excellent service, Dr. Vitor was very attentive and professional during the consultation. He was able to identify all of Gomez's issues, and together with the surgeon who was present at the time, I was able to clear up all my doubts about the next procedures, making me feel more relaxed and confident to proceed. He earned my trust.

Finding this clinic was a turning point in our lives. Dr. Vitor's service is unparalleled. We felt welcomed, well-guided, and confident in the decisions to be made regarding our new puppy. The price was very fair, everything was discussed transparently and with great competence. We are very grateful.

I really liked the service; Dr. Vitor is super attentive, didactic, calm, and, above all, honest. My cat received excellent care, and Dr. Vitor instilled a lot of confidence in his approach and guidance.

What a find! I'm very happy with the service. Right from the first consultation, Dr. Vitor was super attentive and analytical. He was concerned not only with looking at the reported symptom, but also with doing a general analysis of my cat, which led us to discover several things that needed to be treated, things that were there, silently. And that, if it weren't for him, would only have been discovered later, in a critical situation. Dr. Vitor's preventive approach is undoubtedly a differentiator.

I met Vitor through a recommendation when my cat started vomiting a lot. He was always very willing and attentive during consultations. He sat down with me and explained her whole situation. After a battery of tests, I understood that she had kidney stones and one of them was obstructing. It was a very intense process, but I could always count on his support. She needed to have one of her kidneys removed, and I continue to follow every step with him. Besides all that, Vitor is very concerned about the pet owner's condition as well and has always helped me find more viable options to pay for all this treatment. I trust him completely and know that what he's doing is thinking about both the pet and the owner!
Excellent service, a careful and super loving professional with animals, in addition to being concerned with every detail of the animal's health. I highly recommend them!
Very good, I felt very safe with the professional and the care given to my "dog children".

I found him through a Google search because one of my cats was sick, and he's one of the best veterinarians I've ever taken my cats to. Very attentive, caring, my cats were treated extremely well. The test results are quick. I highly recommend him!!!
Dr. Vitor provides impeccable service.
Vitor is very attentive and a sweetheart! He took great care of Pantufa during the tartar removal and now with a urinary tract infection. We will continue to be clients for a long time!

Vitor was very attentive to my kitten, providing quick service without ordering unnecessary tests, charging a fair price, and being very professional. He will definitely be the official veterinarian for my family of 3 cats!
The doctor helped me a lot, answered my questions, and was very attentive.

I went to the clinic to get an injection prescribed by another veterinarian. When I arrived, Dr. Vitor talked to me at length about my dog, and even without me explaining the reasons for the injection, he accurately deduced them all. Furthermore, he warned me about veterinarians affiliated with large pharmaceutical companies. I will certainly continue my dog's treatment with Dr. Vitor.
Wonderful vet. Truly.

Excellent service. I initially went there for an ultrasound exam. Along with the ultrasound, I also received a comment from the veterinarian, which was excellent, since as an accountant, I understand practically nothing about this. I was informed of the severity of the dog's condition and the urgency of the surgery. My dog's veterinarian was traveling, and initially the idea was to wait for him, but since we were very well attended to, I decided to have the surgery there. In the post-operative period, I was attended to even at night without any extra charge. It is important to mention that there are 2 veterinarians in this clinic, Vitor and Amanda, which makes the service even better.

The location is excellent, as it is next to my house, and I don't drive, so I can walk there without major worries. In any case, it is a place with excellent access, many buses pass by, there are taxis, and a bus terminal in front.

It is important to mention that the prices for the services are good, and we can pay by card or PIX.

I have two dogs and I intend to continue with Dr. Vitor and Dr. Amanda from VVet.

My sincere thanks.

I'm very happy with the service, attention, and care I received during the consultation with Dr. Vitor. It was the first time I took my cat, and he identified the problem confidently and provided the necessary guidance in a very clear way. He also suggested several ways to improve my cat's well-being. He earned my trust!

We had our first consultation with Vitor today. He was very attentive, very assertive, and patient with Zeca. He gave us a lot of confidence in all his recommendations, which we started following as soon as we left the office.
I finally found a professional to take care of Zeca!
Excellent service and fair price!

Dr. Vitor is a caring, attentive professional who was truly present throughout my pet's treatment.

Unlike many experiences I've had with other professionals, he NEVER acted abusively, either psychologically or financially. He always clearly explained each step, respecting my decisions and prioritizing the animal's WELL-BEING. I recommend him with confidence.
Fair price, highly competent and attentive veterinarian! I highly recommend him and will return whenever needed!

I took my kitten Zazu to Dr. Vitor today because he was injured, and I have nothing but praise for him!!! Besides being handsome, he was very empathetic, careful, and attentive to Zazu! For anyone who is super worried about their pet and as suspicious as I am, I recommend him 300%!!!!!!

Excellent service. I found the clinic during a difficult time when my dog ​​was in pain. Dr. Vitor quickly diagnosed a cervical hernia, and we treated it precisely and carefully. Later, I adopted another dog who arrived with tick-borne disease, and Dr. Vitor was again very attentive, and we were able to start treatment. We also discussed their diets with him, and today both are doing very well!! We are no longer in São Paulo, but he remains our trusted veterinarian. I highly recommend him!!

Dr. Vitor's attention was perfect. We moved to Brazil in February and he helped us a lot with his patience and the thoughtful gesture of giving us the diagnosis in Spanish. Boro had a diagnosis of chronic dermatitis and Dr. Vitor recommended an ultrasound exam, which helped us find pancreatitis and how it could be affecting his skin. In conclusion, we highly recommend him for his attention and human touch. And also for being considerate of our budget when recommending treatments for Boro. A genius! Thank you very much, Doc! 🐾💜🐕‍🦺👨‍⚕
Exceptional, excellent!

Dr. Vitor was very patient with my skittish kitten and managed to perform the necessary tests without major trauma at an affordable price. The clinic is easily accessible, especially for those who live downtown.
Excellent consultation! Vitor was very attentive, kind, and careful. I took a kitten I rescued for a check-up and to have blood drawn. I recommend him to everyone.

Cozy place and super affectionate and humane professional!

I highly recommend it.
Excellent veterinarian, who examines thoroughly, explains everything, and doesn't push for unnecessary tests or procedures. Highly recommend.

Vitor is an exceptional professional, the kind that's hard to find these days! I found him through recommendations here on Google and I can say that he truly lives up to the hype. We are using his services to monitor and treat some of my 10-year-old Shih Tzu's health and well-being. His genuine concern for her health and well-being, along with his fair prices, further reinforces the excellence of his service. I don't feel cheated like I have in other places I've been. It's a relief to know that my little one is in such competent hands. May God bless you abundantly, Vitor!
Good location
Excellent
Excellent place with quality service and plenty of experience to take my pet to, I highly recommend it!

Dr. Vitor treated the 8 cats at my workplace with great care and attention. He medicated those who needed it, clearly explained all the necessary treatments and care, and will continue to monitor them all.
I highly recommend the clinic and the professional.
Excellent doctor, super kind, and treated my cat wonderfully well. I highly recommend him ❤️❤️

From the very first consultation, Dr. Vitor was very attentive and careful. He explained everything in detail and with great patience, conveying confidence in the care. Ruby felt super comfortable, which made me even more at ease. Furthermore, the support via WhatsApp was quick, clarifying all my doubts. We decided to sign up for the V.Vet preventive health plan. I highly recommend it!
Excellent professional, polite, very nice person, clarified all our doubts.
Dr. Vitor is great! Suki always receives excellent care!!
Wonderful veterinarian, attentive, with fair prices, and no excessive procedures. It had been a long time since I'd found such a well-intentioned professional!

My mother and I were very satisfied and grateful for the care provided by Vitor, who examined our little turtle with true dedication, care, and professionalism, putting us at ease by explaining everything with great patience and clarity. We were impressed by the empathy he showed towards our concern and, without a doubt, we recommend him to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly cares about the health of animals and also listens to and answers the questions of pet owners!
We loved the consultation, the vet was very attentive and professional, I highly recommend him!
I'm so happy to have found a competent and truly committed professional. Thank you so much for all the care and attention you've given my daughters ♡♡ I highly recommend them!
Felipe, my cat, and I love Vitor's work! He's more than a vet, he's a teacher! Very didactic and patient.
Excellent professional and very attentive. He took great care of my guinea pig, Fauna!
I took my pet there, the treatment was very humane, we loved it, and the price wasn't outrageous.
He helped me in an emergency, very helpful and attentive, excellent service, with complete respect for the kitten, who remained super calm.
Great, I loved it! Whenever I need to, I'll take my cats to Dr. Vitor from now on. He's very attentive and a great professional. I recommend him.

It's definitely worth bringing your pet here. Vitor has a different approach than what we experience in other veterinary clinics, as he avoids the profitability model of large stores, exploring the affection of pet owners in a way. This is …
Attentive and experienced professional.
The vet is a sweetheart! Excellent service. He was able to answer our questions and treated us well. If needed, I will definitely return! Flora thanks you.
The doctor is very attentive, the costs are reasonable for real people, and very careful. He gave me a lot of important information about caring for my dog.
Excellent clinic, excellent service!! Very caring and professional, congratulations!! A special thank you to the veterinarian Vitor!!
Highly qualified, friendly, and efficient professional. Easy to find.

I took my Shih Tzu for a check-up. The doctor was very attentive. I highly recommend him. Besides being super kind and gentle with the little ones, he also answered my questions. The price is fair and affordable, and the quality is good.
Excellent service, I was very satisfied!

Dr. Vitor is a great professional! It wasn't one of those rushed consultations; he clarified all my doubts and explained everything clearly. He also didn't push unnecessary tests and treatments, only recommending those that really needed to …
Excellent service, very helpful and affordable price, I recommend it!

My fiancée and I took Geleia for his second vaccination, but what we thought would just be a vaccine application turned into a consultation. Which was wonderful. Vitor is a great professional; he gave us several recommendations about proper …
The veterinarian was super attentive and professional! I loved it, the price was fair, and my cat felt very comfortable.
Vitor is a great professional, very dedicated and friendly ☺️✨
